desc: Implement fast input parsing and build the frequency array up to `M = max(A_i)`.
Compute divisible-element counts for every divisor using a multiples sieve.
Scan feasible divisors in descending order and assign the first feasible divisor to each divisible value.
Generate answers in original input order and write them efficiently to stdout.
Check time and memory usage under the maximum constraints.
Validate correctness on samples and edge cases including `K=1`, `K=N`, duplicates, and pairwise-coprime values.
